_source: Novo Nordisk (NVO) Q2 2026 earnings call. The haystack case: MASH commentary inside a mega-cap call dominated by obesity and diabetes, post-Akero acquisition (announced 9 October 2025, up to $5.2B).
_caveat: DEMO FIXTURE. Assembled from Novo Nordisk's published MASH/efruxifermin disclosures rather than a parsed transcript, so `quote` holds the reported statement, not a verified verbatim span, and `passage_idx` is indicative only. Claims carry provenance='reconstructed' and the digest cites them as such. NOT part of the eval set. The low claim count is the point, not a defect: two MASH claims out of an hour of obesity and diabetes commentary is the signal-to-noise problem this fixture exists to demonstrate.

claims.claim: Novo Nordisk confirmed it is advancing efruxifermin, the FGF21 analogue acquired with Akero, in Phase 3 MASH including compensated cirrhosis.
claims.quote: efruxifermin continues in Phase 3 development in MASH, including compensated cirrhosis
claims.speaker: Martin Holst Lange
claims.reasoning: The closest mechanism rival to Rezdiffra, now funded and commercialised by a mega-cap rather than a single-asset biotech. Directly contests the F4c opportunity Madrigal is guiding to in 2027. Reaches the portfolio on mechanism alone — this call never says 'Madrigal'.

claims.claim: Management framed semaglutide's MASH indication as a broad primary-care opportunity rather than a specialist liver-disease launch.
claims.quote: we see MASH as a natural extension of our cardiometabolic franchise in primary care
claims.speaker: Lars Fruergaard Jorgensen
claims.reasoning: Rezdiffra's prescriber base is concentrated in hepatology and gastroenterology. A primary-care push by a GLP-1 incumbent attacks the channel Madrigal is still nine months into opening in endocrinology.
